response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scan_count, 1.0 * SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc INNER JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT sr.status, sr.total_scan_count, sr.gb_per_minute, sr.gb_per_minute - o.average_rate AS rate_above_average FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sr.gb_per_minute > o.average_rate
